title: Asahina Mafuyu — Unstoppable Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Make sure to keep your shoulder down when you draw your arrow back. Stay calm, focus and take it slow...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, that was excellent...
You remained focused through the release and follow-through.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member
rows.Line:
Phew... Thanks, Asahina.
I should be able to keep my shoulder from rising on its own now.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel really bad about having you watch me practice. I know you have cram school after this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's okay. I was actually hoping to get in a little practice as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, I think I'll get started.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you for the advice!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have some free time until cram school starts now. That means I can keep shooting...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Thankfully, Mom's not stopping me from going to club...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Are those poems also a part of your homework...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because you know what you have to do in order to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I need to breathe...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This shot is all you care about right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Did cram school always end this early...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I wish I kept practicing for a little while longer...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I still have time until curfew...
Maybe I can stop by somewhere before I head home...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Somewhere to take my mind off things... But...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Where can I go to relax that's also close by...?)
